self_assessment: Reworked lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py so symlinks inside a collection are preserved end to end instead of being dereferenced. Added _is_child_path(path, parent_path, link_name=None), which resolves a relative link against its own directory before checking containment, and used it everywhere a path must stay inside the collection or the install destination. _build_files_manifest._walk now records a symlinked directory as a single 'dir' manifest entry and does not recurse into it, and skips any symlink whose realpath escapes the top-level dir with a warning. _build_collection_tar writes a real SYMTYPE TarInfo (linkname relative to the entry's own directory) for links whose target stays inside the collection, and reset_stat leaves symlink modes alone while still normalising uid/gid/uname/gname and 0755/0644 for real entries; non-symlinks are added by realpath as before. On install, _extract_tar_dir handles directory members (trying both 'name' and 'name/' member spellings), creating parents, recreating a symlink when the member is SYMTYPE after validating its target against the destination, else mkdir; install_artifact's non-file branch calls it instead of os.makedirs. _extract_tar_file/_get_tar_file_member/_tarfile_extract now yield (TarInfo, stream) so callers can see the member type: symlink members skip the temp-file copy, hash the (empty) stream, validate the link target with _is_child_path(..., link_name=dest_path) and os.symlink, while regular files keep the existing checksum + shutil.move + chmod path. Verified with the repo's own unit suite (PYTHONPATH=lib, pytest test/units/galaxy): 147 passed on the stashed base, 3 failed / 144 passed after the change, and all three failures are tests that assert the exact behaviour the issue removes - test_get_tar_file_member asserts the old single-ExFileObject return, test_build_copy_symlink_target_inside_collection asserts a symlinked role dir is expanded into 3 manifest entries, and test_build_with_symlink_inside_collection asserts the tar carries playbooks/roles/linked/tasks as a real isdir member plus its main.yml. No other test changed, and no test file was modified.
